points.description: First valid defluoridation technique named, e.g. Nalgonda process / precipitation with alum and lime (coagulation), adsorption on activated alumina or bone char, or anion exchange resin.
points.partial_credit: Half if technique is only vaguely named (e.g. 'adsorption' or 'chemical treatment' with no medium).

points.description: Second, different valid defluoridation technique from the model answer's list (Nalgonda/alum-lime precipitation, adsorption on activated alumina/bone char, anion exchange resin).
points.partial_credit: Half if technique is only vaguely named.

rubric.notes: Full marks for two different correct techniques from the model answer list; clear synonyms are accepted (e.g. alum coagulation for Nalgonda, ion exchange for anion exchange resin). Give 1 mark for one correct technique, or for two vague ones. Wrong or unrelated techniques (e.g. chlorination, boiling) earn nothing, and the same technique named twice in different words counts once.
